scenario_definitions.q3_uniform: 16 omnidirectional sources uniformly distributed by area in the target disk
scenario_definitions.q3_boundary: 16 omnidirectional sources uniformly distributed by area in the 1350--1800 m annulus
scenario_definitions.q3_clustered: 16 omnidirectional sources sampled around one random cluster centre
scenario_definitions.q4_mixed: 8 omnidirectional and 8 directional sources; positions and directional headings are random
scenario_definitions.q4_directional: 16 directional sources with random positions and headings
scenario_definitions.q4_outward: 16 directional sources in the 1150--1800 m annulus, each pointing radially outward

common_assumptions.channels: 16 distinct channels sampled without replacement from 1--20
common_assumptions.bearing_error_deg: independent uniform[-1,1], then rounded to 0.01 degree

scope_note: This harness is independent of the official simulator and supports empirical, not universal, claims.
